snippet.title: Pixel Gun Battle - Dynamic Top Down Shooter in Pixel Art
snippet.description:
🎮 Download Pixel Gun Battle on Google Play: 👉 https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spectr.pixel.gun.battle.free
🔥 Join our Community: https://www.instagram.com/pixel.gun.battle/

Brutal like Brutal Doom and beautiful like Hotline Miami! Pixel Gun Battle is a fast-paced, hardcore 2D top-down shooter where your main mission is simple: destroy all opponents on the level and stay alive.
No time to think — just go ahead and shoot anything that moves! In this retro pixel-art action game, every bullet counts. You will have to think over your moves carefully in order to properly manage your lives and survive the continuous chaos. Pick up powerful firearms, face tons of ruthless enemies, and map out your own tactical path through each challenge.

👇 MAIN FEATURES:
• Pure Top-Down Action: Hardcore single-player survival inspired by HL Miami.
• Tactical Gameplay: Plan your moves to manage your lives and outsmart enemy AI.
• Juicy Visuals: Bright, high-contrast pixel art with explosive combat effects.
• Dynamic Arsenal: Pick up powerful guns and clear the map floor by floor.
• Responsive Controls: Smooth, fast-paced movement fully optimized for mobile devices.
• Gorgeous Sound: Atmospheric retro sound effects and immersive soundtrack.

🎵 Music:
Midnight Danger - The Last Day
Listen on SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com/midnightdanger/the-last-day

For business inquiries and support: spectr.presents@gmail.com
